entries.1166f417db5b994a: Founded in November 1997 in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, for the purpose of computer network consulting and research. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 100, and it has no affiliated companies.
entries.116793b58f06152a: Under the management slogan “One Step Ahead of the Game ～ Sono Ichite-saki e,” and based on the “Asgent Medium- to Long-Term Growth Strategy,” it is expanding its service menu toward introducing the latest security products and providing smart security services. In products, it aims to win large-scale projects for government agencies and enterprises with its existing core products, accelerate sales of new products and build recurring revenue. In services, it intends to promote development of SOC offerings and development toward providing AI-SOC services. In addition, starting from the solution “Hirundo,” which addresses risks inherent in generative AI, it intends to promote service deployment in the security area for AI environments (Security for AI).
entries.12271ff02b476a38: This business provides a combination of importing and selling overseas security products and managed security services that cover monitoring and operation.
entries.165347e21edc9f3e: In a business environment that requires countermeasures against ransomware and supply chain attacks, as well as responses to new security risks accompanying the spread of generative AI, revenue rose 15.5% from the previous year, driven by winning large projects such as new deployments of high-end models for large-scale networks.
entries.1c3e60af709ce2d2: Under the management slogan “One Step Ahead of the Game ～ Sono Ichite-saki e,” and based on the “Asgent Medium- to Long-Term Growth Strategy,” it is expanding its service menu toward introducing the latest security products and providing smart security services.
entries.23697283b84bab77: Its strength lies in combining know-how built through sales of overseas products such as those of Check Point and Menlo (formerly Votiro) with managed security services under its own brand, "Security Plus," allowing it to propose an integrated solution from product introduction through monitoring and operation. The Menlo sanitization solution it handles has ranked No.1 in domestic share of the email and file sanitization market for 8 consecutive years.
entries.24dc66b43ec6f7c3: 【Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address, etc.】 states the business environment of the cybersecurity industry, and 【Management's Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows】 states the winning of large projects and the increase in revenue.
entries.2911e6c2cf174885: It sells network security products centered on products from Check Point and Menlo (formerly Votiro), and provides managed security services under its own brand “Security Plus.”
entries.2f8b6b02073ccd72: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,434 million, up 15.5% from the previous year. It has a single business segment, the Network Security Business only.
entries.3a98b7f57fc73e64: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net income was ¥168 million. The previous fiscal year recorded a net loss of ¥440 million.
entries.3be15bb4df56e674: The filing states the following: under [Business Overview], the import and sale of security-related products and related services; under [Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Position, Results of Operations and Cash Flows], that orders trended mainly for products of Check Point and Menlo (formerly Votiro); and under [History], that the sanitization solution has ranked No.1 in domestic share for 8 consecutive years.
entries.60028f4d2d486910: A single-segment business that sells network security products and comprehensively provides product-combination services that draw on the company's security know-how. In addition to importing and selling security products centered on products of Check Point and Menlo (formerly Votiro), the company provides managed security services under its own brand 'Security Plus'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,434 million for the company as a whole.
